milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The grindstone is at spawn-relative (5, 1, 6) inside the open-faced workshop. The player must navigate close enough to see it and face toward it. max_distance=16 allows detection from the workshop entrance or even from spawn, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the grindstone rather than facing away.

Uses inventory_has because mining a polished granite slab with a pickaxe drops the item into the player's inventory. The player has a wooden pickaxe (given via /give) which is sufficient to mine stone-type slabs. The 6x6 polished granite slab floor (spawn-relative ~3,0,3 to ~8,0,8) provides 36 mineable slabs. After mining at least one slab, it appears in inventory.
